verdict.rationale: Adyen documents relayed authorization for real-time approve/decline of each transaction (JIT-style funding control) and flexible balance structures — a single pooled balance or per-card balances (docs-4, docs-16, docs-14) — which maps to prefunded vs. distributed funding models. However, there is no explicit documentation contrasting 'prefunded' vs 'just-in-time funding' terminology or discussing cash-flow tradeoffs between the two approaches. missing for 10: explicit prefunded-vs-JIT terminology, cash-flow tradeoff guidance/documentation, finance-lead-oriented comparison of funding models.
